key_highlights: ASX tumbles as miners and banks sell off amid $100+ oil spike and rising bond yields (10-yr US Treasury highest since 2023)
RBA flags rental inflation as key concern, raising prospect of further rate tightening or delayed cuts
Iron ore trouble spreads, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
Albanese government softens gas reservation rules, easing Asian supply fears but drawing criticism
Australian dollar weakness risk flagged amid global yield surge and commodity volatility
Queensland near credit rating downgrade; NSW faces stamp duty revenue hit
WA gold exploration activity intensifies (Gateway, Auric, Golden Dragon, Forrestania)
Chinese inflation surges, adding global macro uncertainty

sectors.trend: Sharp sell-off driven by iron ore weakness spreading and oil-driven global risk-off. Gold miners in WA see elevated exploration activity but remain small-cap. Copper stakes rising (Flagship).
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face near-term pressure from iron ore softness. Gold juniors (Gateway, Auric, Golden Dragon) attract speculative flows. Energy majors benefit from $100+ oil.

sectors.trend: Banks under pressure from rising bond yields compressing NIMs and ASX broad sell-off. RBA rental inflation concern signals prolonged tight policy. Private credit stress (Bathla collapse) adds risk.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure. Private credit exposure (Bathla) warrants scrutiny. Queensland downgrade risk affects state-linked lending.

sectors.trend: Oil at $100-105 triggers TACO dynamics. Gas reservation policy shift supports domestic producers. AI data centre demand at coal plants signals structural power demand growth.
sectors.implications: Woods Point, Origin, AGL benefit from gas policy easing and power demand. Coal-to-data-centre pivot (Power giant) creates transition narrative. LNG exporters gain from Asian supply relief.

sectors.trend: Relatively defensive; CSL.AX and WES.AX, WOW.AX provide stability amid volatility. Housing divergence (high-end falling, affordable resilient) supports consumer staples.
sectors.implications: Defensive rotation likely. Property sector (REITs) mixed: high-end weakness vs affordable resilience.

sectors.trend: Global tech sell-off (Intel -6%, NVIDIA/AMD -3%) spills into ASX tech. AI data centre buildout creates domestic infrastructure demand. Battery tech (Critical Resources) in testing phase.
sectors.implications: ASX-listed tech names vulnerable to US sentiment. Data centre infrastructure plays gain structural tailwind.

key_themes: Oil spike to $100-105 driving global risk-off and ASX sell-off
RBA rental inflation focus complicates rate cut timeline
Iron ore demand weakness spreading through Chinese inflation data
Gas reservation policy shift reshapes energy investment landscape
AUD weakness risk from yield divergence and commodity volatility
Housing market bifurcation: luxury correction vs affordable resilience
WA gold exploration boom continues across small/mid caps
AI data centre power demand creating energy transition tension

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil spike to $105 and rising global bond yields
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; reduce duration in fixed income; favour domestic energy producers over importers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA policy uncertainty from rental inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor RBA statements; favour rate-sensitive REITs cautiously; hold quality financials with strong NIMs
Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weightings; rotate into gold and copper exposure
Hedge USD-denominated liabilities; favour export-oriented miners with AUD revenue

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Queensland credit downgrade and state fiscal stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid QLD-linked infrastructure and property plays; monitor NSW stamp duty revenue
Review bank private credit exposures; avoid illiquid credit instruments

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight domestic energy and gas producers
opportunities.rationale: Gas reservation easing plus $100+ oil supports margins; AI data centre power demand structural tailwind
Multiple high-grade hits (Gateway $45M, Auric 102koz, Golden Dragon) signal sector upcycle; gold hedges oil-driven inflation

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive tilt to quality healthcare and consumer staples
opportunities.rationale: Housing bifurcation and rate uncertainty favour defensive cash-flow businesses

defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore trouble spreading amid Chinese inflation surge; demand outlook deteriorating

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD and reduce rate-sensitive REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA rental inflation focus delays cuts; AUD shock risk; high-end property correction underway

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid QLD-linked and private credit exposures
defensive_moves.rationale: Queensland downgrade risk; Bathla collapse signals private credit fragility

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1-3 months. Oil at $100+, rising yields, and iron ore weakness create headwinds. RBA rental inflation focus limits rate cut hopes. Expect volatility around ^AXJO with miners and banks leading declines. Gold juniors and energy names offer relative strength.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil normalises and RBA pivots. Gas policy shift supports energy investment cycle. WA gold exploration pipeline maturing. Housing bifurcation stabilises. Key risk: prolonged Chinese slowdown and global yield spike.
